modules.module_title: Pre-Operation check of crusher and crusher sites

pcs.pc_description: check the electric panel and electric supply before starting the crusher
check availability of raw materials at the site
inspect the moveable parts in crushers like conveyor belts, rollers, stringers, etc. for wear and tear
check Vertical Shaft Impactor (VSI) crusher, tips, liners, etc.
coordinate with other vehicle operators for procurement of the raw material as per standards of the organisation
inspect the suitable fire extinguishers and automatically operated fire suppression system and devices including automatic fire detection system at site

interpret the layout and identify components of belt conveyor system including its principal components like, trough, conveyor belt, clips, roller, guards, tensioners, feed and discharge chutes, head, tail and take-up pulleys, bearings, controls such as switches, trip cords, Inter locks, alarms, etc.
discuss the operations of mechanical and electrical driving units including safety devices
conduct conveying of the ore to the processing unit considering parameters like feed/ material rate, alignment of conveyor belts, spillage amount and rate, conveyor jams etc.
take corrective actions against any safety hazards
conduct operational checks on areas of potential issues like unusual noises/ smells, blockages and obstruction, lubrication of drive head, tail end and rollers , leaks, ensure magnets are operative
take corrective actions on any unusual issues observed during operational checks
check principal components of hoppers and bins, like grizzly rails, chutes, guardrails etc.

modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: comply with safety, health, and security- related regulations/guidelines at the opencast mine
follow the safety instructions given by the workman's inspector
follow adequate safety while working at haul roads, heights, overburden dumps, sump area, stockyard, near moving parts, etc.
take safety precautions while working on sites (sub-station, workshop etc.), with equipment, and conducting welding and cutting operations
follow appropriate Safe Operating Procedure (SOP) while dealing with explosives
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or an emergency situation, within limits of the role and responsibility
provide first aid to an injured person
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at a worksite when required
use appropriate PPE as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify the environmental impact of related opencast mining operations
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
ensure not to mix topsoil with waste in day to day tasks
ensure that HEMM is washed at the designated location
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the mineral conservation practices specified by the organization in accordance with MCDR-2017 (Mineral Conservation and Development Rules)
assist supervisor for reducing environmental impact caused due to related mining operations

modules.module_title: Recognize the ore processing requirements and related parameters

pcs.pc_description: recognize the ore processing methodology and process to be adopted through discussions with the supervisor and reading the process manuals/ work instructions/standard operating procedures
discuss various reagents and their quantities to be used as well as effective reagents handling techniques
monitor the reagent addition rate and mix tank levels continuously during the ore processing
identify the various tools to be used at different steps of ore processing like hand & power tools, pneumatically & hydraulically powered tools, scaffolds, ladders etc.
perform the operations of various equipment used at various stages like mobile equipment and lifting equipment
identify the operations for various tools & equipment as well as the effective equipment handling guidelines
prepare for the emergency situations with required instructions and equipment in place
conduct checks on various operational parameters like tank level, ph level, reagent usage, air parameters, alarms, pumps, screens, monitors etc.
add reagents as required, such as acids, carbon, cyanide, calcium as per the process requirements
conduct leaching/ ore beneficiation process to extract the minerals from the grinded ores
check and monitor threshold limit values (tlvs)
guard all identified hazards using rope/barriers and/or signs, clean up spills and leaks, report condition to appropriate personnel
check various separation systems like drive system, drums, concentrators, jigs, classifiers etc.
check various operating parameters like operating levels, pressures, cleanliness
ensure the maintenance of flow rate
check and monitor threshold limit values (tlvs)
guard all identified hazards using rope/barriers and/or signs, clean up spills and leaks, report condition to appropriate personnel

identify the different types of floatation equipment including floatation air, bank of cells, conditioner, collector, floatation column, cells, such as: roughers, scavenger, cleaners, pumping system in-line assay system
start the floatation system and ensure adequate flow
control the quantity of reagents, percent solid, addition of air, level of froth/pulp, launder water, pump speed, ph level
stop floatation circuit in sequence
ensure that the reagent systems contain proper amount, type and strength of reagents
identify different types of dewatering systems including stock tanks, decanters, pumping systems, sampling systems, rakes, drive system, feed wells etc.
operate and maintain dewatering system while checking the shell, rakes (e.g. height, integrity), motor and gear box for unusual noises, pumps, water supply, pumps and valves etc.
guard all identified hazards using rope/barriers and/or signs, clean up spills and leaks, report condition to appropriate personnel

identify the different types of filtration systems and components including stock tanks, pumping systems, sampling systems, drive systems, lubrication systems, hydraulic systems, pneumatic systems, vacuum systems, filter cloth
check the functioning of vacuum system, gear box, bearings etc.
check the condition of the filter (e.g. thickness of filter cake)
conduct filtration while controlling the moisture, filtrate, wash water, pump speed, pressure, density etc.
monitor boot levels and agitation
